messages.text: Hi, I returned the leather crossbody bag, the colour was not what the photo showed. I'd like a refund.

tool_calls.name: propose_refund
tool_calls.arguments: {"order_id":"h20-o1","unit_ids":["h20-o1-u1"],"summary_for_staff":"Customer requests refund for returned leather crossbody bag because its colour did not match the photo."}

messages.name: propose_refund
messages.content: {"ok": true, "proposal_id": "prop-1461bf56a44047a3", "status": "awaiting_customer_confirmation", "outcome": "eligible", "amount_minor": 9350, "currency": "BRL", "policy_citations": [], "next_step": "Tell the customer the amount. They confirm with the button on the proposal card; a typed yes is not a confirmation."}

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"customer confirmation proposal card button staff review before refund"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/approval", "title": "Confirmation and approval", "text": "Every refund needs two separate decisions: the customer confirms the exact proposal (items, quantities and amount) with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member approves it. Changing anything in a proposal needs a new proposal, a new confirmation and a new approval. A staff member cannot approve a refund that this policy does not allow."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/payout", "title": "When the money is paid", "text": "The shop pays a refund only when all of these hold: the order qualifies, the request was on time, the units were received back and not refunded before, the order has one valid payment, the customer confirmed, a staff member approved, and the proposal is still valid. The refund is complete only when the customer has a receipt; until then nothing is reported as refunded."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text: Your returned leather crossbody bag is eligible for a **R$93.50** refund. Please confirm using the button on the proposal card; a typed “yes” won’t confirm it. A staff member will then review your request. (refund-policy/v1/approval)

The customer confirmed request prop-1461bf56a44047a3, but a staff member rejected it, so nothing will be paid. The staff member gave this reason for the customer: "The returned bag has a stain on the strap."
Your refund request was rejected by a staff member because the returned bag has a stain on the strap. No refund has been paid.
I never used the bag; I only took it out of the box. I don’t accept this decision. Can I speak to a person?

messages.text: A person will take over to review your dispute. I’ve passed along that you never used the bag and only took it out of the box, and that you disagree with the rejection.
